basics.summary: Logical and organised software engineer with around three years of hands-on experience building and shipping full-stack web applications. Comfortable across the JavaScript ecosystem—React, Angular, Node.js, and Express—with solid work on APIs, databases (MongoDB, MySQL), and cloud-oriented tooling. I translate business requirements into clear, maintainable solutions, care about performance and code quality, and collaborate well in agile teams through clear communication, code review, and shared ownership. Currently pursuing an MSc in Computer Science at the University of East London; open to roles where I can keep growing as a full-stack developer with a forward-looking company.

bullets: Migrated 5+ core modules, improving application structure and reducing code redundancy by 30%.
Led a team of 4 developers, task distribution, sprint planning, and code reviews to meet 100% project deadlines.
Optimized backend APIs and database queries, improving overall application performance by 25–30%.
Implemented AWS services (Redis caching, WebSocket), improving response time by 35% and real-time updates for 1,000+ users.
Developed and maintained 3+ production-level web applications using the MEAN stack.
Designed and optimized REST APIs handling 10,000+ monthly transactions with secure authentication and validation.
